_comment: Hooks for symfony-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed PHP file with PHP-CS-Fixer. Tries Docker first (service 'php'), falls back to the local vendor binary, swallows errors so it never blocks the user.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -j '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.stdout.write(json.load(sys.stdin)["tool_input"]["file_path"])' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.php) docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 'n=config-protection.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" '.php-cs-fixer.php' '.php-cs-fixer.dist.php' 'phpstan.neon*' '.editorconfig'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (.php-cs-fixer.php;.php-cs-fixer.dist.php;phpstan.neon*;.editorconfig) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 'n=post-implement-check.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress` once after this stack's architect finishes and relays failures to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Silent when the tool is absent or no run is active.
